Step V4b: the timing kit of tests/rules/v30time.py run on the owner's A7100
(NEC V30 at 15 MHz, memory with 3 or 4 wait states) under MUTOS 1700,
reported 2026-11-21 (STATUS.md, "Step V4b"). The file log as the machine
wrote it; the lines starting "#" are not the machine's. A timing line is
the unit, x and m (hex), the iterations of a call, the calls, and the
ticks (1/20 s) of the K1 run (8 copies) and of the K2 run (72 copies);
"v30time.py --analyze" turns them into clocks.
